title: Sets and Venn Diagrams
seo_title: Sets – SSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Use set notation; find unions, intersections and complements; draw and use Venn diagrams with two and three sets; solve word problems. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 1 maths worksheets on sets: notation, subsets, union, intersection, complement and Venn diagram word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B)
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A ∪ B has everything in A or B (or both). A ∩ B has only what is in both.
  • A′ (the complement) is everything in the universal set that is not in A.
  • Fill a Venn diagram from the middle (the intersection) outwards.

Examples

Example

n(A) = 15, n(B) = 12, n(A ∩ B) = 5

15 + 12 − 5

Answer: n(A ∪ B) = 22

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the intersection twiceTake it away once.
Mixing up ∪ and ∩∪ looks like a cup that holds everything.
Forgetting the elements outside A and BThey belong to the universal set.

items.q: ξ = {x : x is an integer and 1 ≤ x ≤ 12} and A = {x : x is an even number}. Which statement is true?
items.e: A = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12}. 9 is not in A, so 9 ∉ A. (∈ is for elements; ⊂ is for sets.)

items.q: ξ = {x : x is an integer and 1 ≤ x ≤ 12} and A = {x : x is an odd number}. Find n(A).
items.e: A = {1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11}, so n(A) = 6 (the number of elements).

items.q: ξ = {x : x is an integer and 1 ≤ x ≤ 10} and A = {x : x is a perfect square}. Which statement is true?
items.e: Every element of {1} is in A = {1, 4, 9}, so it is a subset: {1} ⊆ A.

items.q: ξ = {x : x is an integer and 1 ≤ x ≤ 15} and A = {x : x is a multiple of 3}. Find n(A).
items.e: A = {3, 6, 9, 12, 15}, so n(A) = 5 (the number of elements).

items.q: Which of these is the empty set?
c: {x : x is an odd number less than 2}
{x : x is an even prime number greater than 2}
items.e: There is no even prime greater than 2, so that set has no elements: ∅. {0} and {∅} each have one element.
